model.catLabel: Trenchmaster 150 manual (PDF, no public parts book)
model.note: Part outlines are traced from Agriquip's field photo of a Trenchmaster 150 working in a trench, so the lower cutter leg is partly in the ground; outlines are approximate. The gearbox oil, tractor set-up and PM checklist are listed without outlines. No part numbers are published: order cutters, bearings and blades from Trenchmaster by model and year from the ID plate.

hood.name: Top cover and top plate
hood.desc: When hitching, set the top link so the top plate slopes down toward the tractor at about 20-25 deg; the best cut is with the top plate parallel to the ground while trenching. Check all bolts and components before and during work (damage from loose bolts is not covered by warranty). After use wash off soil and store the trencher dry and under cover.

front.name: Front housing
front.desc: Check all bolts and components before and during work (damage from loose bolts is not covered by warranty). After use wash off soil and store the trencher dry and under cover.

frame.name: Main frame
frame.desc: Annual: check the frame and 3-point mounts for cracks and re-torque all bolts. Weight 285 kg (manual) or 290 kg (Agriquip page); 1.8 x 1.1 x 0.93 m.

headstock.name: Lower link pins and brackets
headstock.desc: 3-point linkage: connect the linkage and the PTO before use. Annual: check the 3-point mounts for cracks and re-torque the bolts.

topmount.name: Top link mount
topmount.desc: Set the top link so the top plate slopes down toward the tractor at about 20-25 deg; adjust so the top plate runs parallel to the ground while cutting.

eye.name: Lifting eye
eye.desc: Lifting point on the top cover (trencher about 285 kg).

pto.name: PTO shaft and guard
pto.desc: Grease the universal joints and the slip joint with all-purpose grease each use (manual: 'regularly'). Cut the shaft to suit at trenching depth: it closes up as the machine digs, and a shaft too long at full depth damages the tractor and the trencher. Check the overlap and that all guards are intact and secured. Cross kits and guard: size from the label on the fitted shaft (not stated in the manual).

leg.name: Cutter leg
leg.desc: Gearbox-driven cutter leg with replaceable tungsten-tipped auger cutters (not a digging chain: Notion's chain, chain guide, tension spring and sprocket rows TM-150-CHN / CG / TS / SP look invented, so remove them unless the unit physically has a chain). Trench 150 mm wide (300 mm with the adaptor), 100-800 mm deep. Notion's 'boom pivot bushings, grease weekly' is not in the manual: the only lube points are the gearbox oil, the driveline and the cutter-leg nipple.

cutters.name: Tungsten-tipped auger cutters
cutters.desc: Before use: cutters sharp and all present. Annual: inspect the cutters and tungsten tips. Part numbers are not published: order from Trenchmaster by machine model and year from the ID plate (manual 5.3). Notion's TM-T150 is not a confirmed number.

plough.name: Spoil plough and depth setting
plough.desc: The trencher cuts down to the depth set on the spoil plough (100-800 mm, set with 2 bolts); reset it for each pass if several passes are needed. Annual: inspect the spoil plough and the depth-control blade.

gearbox.name: Gearbox oil
gearbox.desc: 90-grade extreme-pressure gear oil (SAE 90 EP); capacity not stated, fill to the level plug. Check the level before use. The manual says check it at regular intervals and replace it periodically (no hours): change it yearly or before an irrigation project (best practice for a low-hour machine). Notion's '80W-140' is not in the manual.

tractor.name: Tractor set-up and operation
tractor.desc: Minimum 30 hp, 3-point linkage, PTO max 1000 rpm (optimum 520 rpm). To trench: engage the 1000 PTO, select the lowest gear, lower the linkage, bring the engine to about 1200 rpm and drive forward; it cuts down to the depth set on the spoil plough. Up to 1 km/h in good ground, slower in hard ground: too fast and it rides out of the cut or stalls the tractor. A creeper or hydrostatic tractor is ideal; several passes may be needed.

records.name: PM checklist
records.desc: taskTracker has no PM template for the trencher: add a pre-use checklist (bolts, guards, gearbox level, grease the driveline, hourly cutter-leg grease in heavy ground) and an annual service (gearbox oil, cutters, bearings, frame). Manual is the NZ distributor's edition; Australian supply is via the maker (trenchmasterdigger.com), not confirmed.

foot.name: Cutter leg foot, grease nipple and cutter bearings
foot.desc: The grease nipple is in the bottom of the cutter leg, reached with the trencher lifted on the 3-point linkage. In heavy going give it 2-3 shots of all-purpose grease every hour to protect the cutter bearings: they fail early if not greased hourly in heavy ground. Annual: check the bearings for play and noise. Bearing part numbers are not published (order from Trenchmaster).
